name: print-social-black-and-white-festival-poster-with-star-halftone-eye-and-spiral
title: Black and white 'VINTAGE IS A FESTIVAL' poster with a star, a halftone eye and an op-art spiral in three boxes
whatItIs: A black textured field with a huge heavy white title 'VINTAGE IS A FESTIVAL®' where IS is reversed in a white box, and below three white-outlined boxes: a stylised star, a halftone dot close-up of an eye and a swirling op-art spiral.
whatItMeans: Loud and retro; three graphic techniques in boxes show the festival's mix of eras.
techniques: Reverse one word in a white box.
Show three image treatments in three boxes.

vocabulary.definition: A word in a box with inverted colours.
Three framed image boxes in a row.
